div.head: Ine 76.1
div.ab: Gif hit þonne sy cyninges godsunu, bete be his were þam cyninge swa same swa þære mægþe.
Gif hit þonne kyninges godsunu sie, bete be his were þam cyninge swa ilce swa þære mægþe.
Si sit filiolus regis, emendet secundum weram eius regi sicut cognationi.
Gif hit þonne kyninges godsunu sie, bete be his were þam cyninge swa ilce swa þære mægþe.
If, however, it is the king’s godson, let him pay his wer to the king as well as to the kin.
If, however, it is the godson of a king [who is slain], a compensation equivalent to the wergeld shall be paid to the king, as well as [the wergeld itself] to the kindred.
If, however, it is the king’s godson, his wergild is to be paid to the king the same as to the kindred.
Wenn es [der Erschlagene] jedoch ein Taufsohn des Königs ist, so büsse [Thät]er durch dessen Wergeld dem Könige ebenso [viel] wie der Sippe [des Erschlagenen].
But if it [the slain man] is a godson of the king, let the [kill]er compensate the king according to his wergeld just as [much] as the kindred [of the slain man].
